core.accounts.setting.superuser_session_: How long a superuser stays signed in
The break-glass superuser signs in again after this long. From 10 minutes to 24 hours.
core.accounts.setting.password_min_lengt: The fewest characters a new password may have. From 12 to 128.
core.accounts.setting.login_failure_limi: How many wrong passwords for one e-mail address are allowed within the window below before sign-in pauses. From 3 to 100.
core.accounts.setting.client_failure_lim: Wrong passwords from one device or network
The same, counted per device or network address. Many people share one address at a venue, so keep it at least as high as the limit above. From 10 to 1000.
core.accounts.setting.login_failure_wind: How long failed sign-ins are counted
Failed attempts older than this are forgotten. From 1 minute to 24 hours.
